l4_steps.name: Capture new member application data
l4_steps.input: New member sign-up form via web, mobile app, or in-flight registration
l4_steps.output: Pending member profile record with email, name, contact details
l4_steps.kpi: Enrollment completion rate ≥97%; form abandonment rate <3%
l4_steps.pain_point: Members signing up through multiple channels (web, mobile, GDS booking) without email deduplication create duplicate records that inflate reported membership figures by up to 8%

l4_steps.name: Validate identity and deduplicate profile
l4_steps.input: Pending member profile record
l4_steps.output: Verified, deduplicated member record or merge notification
l4_steps.kpi: Duplicate member rate <0.5% of active member base
l4_steps.pain_point: GDS-sourced bookings frequently lack email address, producing orphaned accounts that cannot be auto-merged; manual resolution queues exceed 5,000 records per month at large carriers

l4_steps.name: Assign base tier and post welcome bonus miles
l4_steps.input: Verified member record
l4_steps.output: Active member account with base tier, welcome bonus posted
l4_steps.kpi: Welcome bonus posting accuracy 100%; account activation within 24 hours of enrollment
l4_steps.pain_point: Tier assignment rules not synchronised in real time between Comarch and Amadeus Altéa PSS; boarding pass may display incorrect tier for first flight taken within hours of enrollment

l4_steps.name: Ingest flight segment data from PSS
l4_steps.input: Completed flight manifest and boarded-passenger segment records
l4_steps.output: Raw accrual transaction records staged in Comarch queue
l4_steps.kpi: Post-flight accrual data ingestion SLA ≤72 hours; segment match rate ≥99%
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa segment data may arrive with codeshare operating-carrier code mismatch, causing failed accrual lookups for interline and partner flights; exception queue can spike after irregular operations

l4_steps.name: Calculate eligible miles per booking class
l4_steps.input: Raw accrual transaction + fare class accrual rate table
l4_steps.output: Calculated mile award amount per segment
l4_steps.kpi: Accrual calculation accuracy ≥99.8%; rules table refresh within 4 hours of fare class change
l4_steps.pain_point: Complex earning multipliers for co-brand card holders are not reflected in real time if card-link data lags from bank partner API by 24–48 hours; members earn base miles then must request adjustment

l4_steps.name: Post miles to member account
l4_steps.input: Validated calculated mile award
l4_steps.output: Posted transaction on member account ledger; balance updated
l4_steps.kpi: Miles posting success rate ≥99.9%; failed posting retry resolution within 4 hours
l4_steps.pain_point: API timeout during peak post-travel periods (Monday 06:00–09:00 local) causes transaction queuing; backlog can delay posting beyond the 72-hour SLA, generating member service contacts

l4_steps.name: Process retro-credit claim for missing miles
l4_steps.input: Member-submitted missing miles claim with booking reference and boarding pass
l4_steps.output: Approved retro-credit posting or rejection notification
l4_steps.kpi: Retro-claim resolution ≤5 business days; auto-approval rate for flight claims ≥70%
l4_steps.pain_point: Partner hotel and car-rental claims require manual verification due to absence of real-time partner transaction feeds; average handle time for partner retro-claims is 3× that of flight claims

l4_steps.name: Aggregate qualifying activity for tier review
l4_steps.input: 12-month rolling transaction history from Comarch Loyalty Management
l4_steps.output: Tier qualification summary per member (qualifying miles, segments, spend)
l4_steps.kpi: Tier calculation batch processing time <4 hours for membership base ≥1M; completed by 02:00 local on qualification date
l4_steps.pain_point: Year-end tier rollover processing creates Comarch database contention; programmes with >2M active members have experienced rollover jobs exceeding the maintenance window, delaying tier notifications by up to 48 hours

l4_steps.name: Evaluate tier upgrade or downgrade eligibility
l4_steps.input: Tier qualification summary per member
l4_steps.output: Tier change decision (upgrade, downgrade, maintain) per member record
l4_steps.kpi: Tier assignment accuracy rate 100%; exception case resolution ≤2 business days
l4_steps.pain_point: Tier criteria differ between earned-status and status-match members; exceptions are managed via manual spreadsheet outside Comarch, creating audit trail gaps and occasional erroneous downgrades that drive high-value member complaints

l4_steps.name: Notify member of tier change and updated benefits
l4_steps.input: Tier change decision from Comarch Loyalty Management
l4_steps.output: Personalised tier upgrade or downgrade notification email
l4_steps.kpi: Email open rate ≥35% for tier upgrade notifications; send within 2 hours of tier change
l4_steps.pain_point: Salesforce Marketing Cloud integration with Comarch runs on nightly batch; real-time tier changes (e.g., reached Gold at midnight) are not reflected in communications until the following morning, delaying member recognition

l4_steps.name: Provision tier benefits and flags in PSS
l4_steps.input: New tier assignment from Comarch Loyalty Management
l4_steps.output: Updated member profile in Altéa with lounge access, priority boarding, and SSR flags
l4_steps.kpi: Benefit provisioning SLA ≤2 hours post-tier assignment; SSR flag accuracy 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa profile update does not propagate to codeshare or interline partner carrier systems; lounge access flags may be absent on partner-operated flights, requiring manual override at airport — a top-5 elite member complaint driver

l4_steps.name: Search and display award flight availability
l4_steps.input: Member redemption request with desired origin, destination, and dates
l4_steps.output: Award availability display with applicable mile costs by fare bucket
l4_steps.kpi: Award availability search response time ≤3 seconds; award seat availability ≥5% of cabin capacity on operated flights
l4_steps.pain_point: Award seat inventory is managed in a separate Altéa RM bucket from revenue inventory; RM team allocation rules are not always aligned with redemption demand, resulting in sub-optimal award availability that pushes members to competitors

l4_steps.name: Validate member miles balance and expiry status
l4_steps.input: Member account query triggered by redemption request
l4_steps.output: Confirmed available balance and expiry date; warning if miles expire within 90 days
l4_steps.kpi: Balance check API response time ≤1 second; expiry warning accuracy 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: Miles expiry rules differ by programme tier and earning source; expired-miles disputes are consistently in the top-3 contact centre drivers, each requiring manual audit of the 24-month transaction ledger

l4_steps.name: Process award booking and deduct miles
l4_steps.input: Confirmed award selection and validated miles balance from Comarch
l4_steps.output: Award PNR in Altéa and corresponding miles deduction transaction in Comarch
l4_steps.kpi: Redemption processing success rate ≥99.5%; dual-system transaction completion within 60 seconds
l4_steps.pain_point: Dual-system transaction (Altéa PNR creation + Comarch deduction) has no atomic rollback; if Altéa confirms the PNR but Comarch times out, miles are not deducted, creating liability; or vice versa creating orphaned PNRs

l4_steps.name: Issue award ticket via GDS or NDC channel
l4_steps.input: Confirmed award PNR
l4_steps.output: Issued award e-ticket with ATPCO award fare code
l4_steps.kpi: Award ticket issuance within 15 minutes of booking confirmation; ticketing failure rate <0.3%
l4_steps.pain_point: ATPCO award fare filing delays can cause ticketing failures when a carrier updates its award chart mid-season without providing adequate lead time; agents must manually override fare basis codes, increasing error risk

l4_steps.name: Ingest partner earn transactions via SFTP or API
l4_steps.input: Partner transaction data files (hotel, car rental, retail) via SFTP or REST API
l4_steps.output: Staged partner transaction records in data lake for Comarch processing
l4_steps.kpi: Partner file ingestion within 24 hours of transaction; data completeness rate ≥98%
l4_steps.pain_point: Partner data formats are inconsistent across up to 15 active earn partners; each non-standard SFTP feed requires a bespoke ETL transform in AWS, with schema changes by partners breaking pipelines and delaying member mile postings

l4_steps.name: Reconcile co-brand card spend accruals with bank
l4_steps.input: Co-brand card transaction data from bank partner API and Comarch accrual ledger
l4_steps.output: Reconciled mile liability journal entry; variance report for disputes
l4_steps.kpi: Reconciliation completion within 3 business days of month-end; variance rate <0.1% of total miles issued
l4_steps.pain_point: Bank API transaction data is typically 24–48 hours delayed; real-time card spend accrual SLA commitments made to co-brand cardholders are not achievable with batch feeds, requiring liability provisioning estimates that create month-end restatements

l4_steps.name: Invoice partner for mile liability and settle AR
l4_steps.input: Reconciled mile liability from co-brand and earn partner transactions
l4_steps.output: Partner invoice (AR document) and settlement confirmation
l4_steps.kpi: Invoice issued within 5 business days of month-end; DSO on partner invoices ≤30 days
l4_steps.pain_point: Mile valuation disputes with hotel and retail partners are a recurring AR collection risk; no contractual SLA governs partner dispute resolution timelines, and unresolved disputes can age beyond 90 days before escalation

l4_steps.name: Segment members by engagement and lifetime value
l4_steps.input: Full member transaction, redemption, and flight history
l4_steps.output: Member segments: active, at-risk, lapsed, high-value
l4_steps.kpi: Segmentation model refresh ≤weekly; at-risk identification lead time ≥30 days before predicted churn
l4_steps.pain_point: Member lifetime value model is not updated in real time; at-risk interventions may lag by up to 7 days after engagement drops, reducing campaign effectiveness for time-sensitive retention windows

l4_steps.name: Design and launch targeted retention campaign
l4_steps.input: At-risk and lapsed member segment lists from AWS Redshift
l4_steps.output: Deployed retention campaign (miles bonus, status extension offer, or upgrade voucher)
l4_steps.kpi: Campaign redemption rate ≥8% for re-engagement offers; unsubscribe rate <0.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: GDPR and CCPA consent management in Salesforce Marketing Cloud is not always synchronised with Comarch consent flags; sending campaigns to members who have opted out in Comarch but not yet in SFMC creates regulatory exposure and potential fines

l4_steps.name: Measure programme ROI and report to leadership
l4_steps.input: Campaign results, financial data from SAP S/4HANA, and booking attribution data
l4_steps.output: Monthly programme ROI dashboard and executive summary
l4_steps.kpi: Monthly ROI report delivered by day 5 of following month; programme break-even mile cost ≤$0.012 per mile issued
l4_steps.pain_point: Revenue attribution between loyalty-driven incremental bookings and organic demand is methodologically contested; commercial, finance, and loyalty teams use different attribution models, producing materially different ROI figures that undermine programme investment decisions
